references.text: The spies' report on the Anakim and the great fortified cities in Canaan, which Caleb refers to in his prayer
The Lord's promise to Caleb that he would receive the land he had explored because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly
Reference to the Anakim and the great fortified cities that the Israelites feared
Description of the great and fortified cities and the people of the Anakim that Israel was to encounter
Joshua's destruction of the Anakim from the hill country, including the Hebron area that Caleb requested
The fulfillment of Caleb's prayer when he received Hebron and drove out the three sons of Anak
Hebron is mentioned as the place where the Anakim lived, the same area Caleb requested
Caleb received Hebron as Moses had promised, and drove out the three sons of Anak
